_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. The mutation vocabulary belongs to one subset of one standard of one artifact, so its oracle registrations and catalog live here. The Python implementation remains supplemental algebra evidence; the production ZIP register carrier now gives all 14 mutations a qualifying third-party reader.

oracles.rationale:
A second implementation of the `s.architect.program` architectural-brief document and all 14 typed mutations, in Python, at `../../../../../🧪️tests/mutate-program-1/🐍️component.py`. Written from `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🔣️.json` (the 14 payload shapes: the four generic register-row payloads — a tagged `{register,row}` record for create and replace, `{register,id}` for delete and `{register,id,newName}` for rename — plus the edge and facet payloads), from `../🧬️schema/📸️snapshot/🔣️.json` (the register list and its order), from rules 1, 2 and 4 of `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️12/SEMANTIC-MUTATIONS-OVERHAUL/📓️derivation-rules.md`, and from the committed `(before, mutation, after, outcome)` specification vectors — which are the only statement of three facts: that a `connect-` verb NORMALISES the edge it appends, that an absent id is `mutation.target-missing` with the id as its path rather than a no-op, and that the 47th register is serialized `artifacts` although the committed JSON Schema requires `documents`. It imports nothing from this repository and transliterates none of its Rust; no file under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<domain>/<op>/{🦀️.rs,↩️inverse,🔺️diff}` was read. This registration SUPERSEDES the `architect-program-mutation-semantics` no-oracle decision, whose argument — that a vocabulary derived by `📓️derivation-rules.md` is a specification no external implementation could confirm or refute — was refuted by the fifteen `📕️norm` references, which were written from that same document. A third-party library was declined, not merely absent: IFC and its property sets carry a built model rather than the brief that precedes it, requirements-management schemas (ReqIF, SysML) carry requirement records but no 66-register brief and no closed 14-verb algebra over it, and none of them reads this carrier. The reference REFUSES three of the case's scenarios by clause rather than adjudicating them, and says so in role: `create-register-row` over `knowledgeRecord` and `benchmarkRecord`, whose whole observable effect is a content address of a composed `s.stdio.semio@v1/table` child that no document in this repository defines; and `identity-round-trip`, whose `.dsl.semio` carrier has only the repository-wide placeholder grammar `payload = OCTET+` while the notation flattens nested records into `key=key=value` and every record `$def` in the committed JSON Schema is an empty `{"type": "object", "additionalProperties": true}` stub. `package` is deliberately empty: the implementation needs no distribution, so this entry contributes nothing to `🔒️dependencies.json`.

UNDER PROTOCOL V2 this registration is classified `cross-semio-implementation` — a required SUPPLEMENTAL oracle that does not discharge `program-1-mutate`'s external-oracle requirement for its 14-kind mutation vocabulary; a qualifying third-party reference (`third-party-library` / `third-party-cli` / `standards-reference-tool`) is still owed.

productionDebt.plan: The same reach the `zip` oracle records in 🌎️hub/🧩️compositions/🗄️stdio/🔮️oracles/🔣️.json: the OS host declares an optional `zip` dependency for container handling. This oracle's subject does not link it; the stdio and architect crates keep `zip` as a dev-dependency. The debt retires when the host routes containers through ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio's own encode_zip/decode_zip.

oracles.rationale: The production architect program exporter maps all 66 registers plus the program, meta, project and governance singleton blocks to seventy JSON members in a real ZIP archive. Each mutation subject first proves its typed result against the committed vector and proves that every non-guard mutation changes this carrier projection; the oracle then receives those exact subject bytes and independently decompresses every member with zip 6 before parsing and comparing its JSON. The reader never links architect, applies a mutation, predicts a row or trusts the repository ZIP decoder, so a silent empty archive, a missing register, corrupt compression or dropped content diverges externally.

The architect subject emits the production ECMA-376 workbook for a populated committed program and the oracle receives those exact bytes. Calamine 0.36 independently opens every worksheet and resolves every non-empty cell into the same row, column and typed-value projection prepared from the logical XlsxSnapshot before encoding. It never imports architect or stdio's XLSX decoder, so an empty workbook, missing register sheet, dropped field, malformed package or incorrect cell encoding is an external divergence.
